info.title: DabDash Tenant API
info.description: REST facade over the DabDash tenant MCP tools. Every operation here dispatches into the exact same handler the tenant MCP server (/mcp) calls — the two surfaces cannot drift apart. Served from each tenant's own subdomain or mapped custom domain, never from the platform domain.

servers.description: Your store's subdomain (e.g. {your-store-slug}.dabdash.com) or mapped custom domain.

tenantDomain.description: Your store's subdomain or custom domain — never the platform domain.

tenantApiKey.description: A tenant MCP token (dmcp_...) minted from the vendor dashboard at /admin/settings/mcp.

enabled.description: Enable or disable abandoned-cart recovery emails.

delay_hours.description: Hours a cart must remain idle before recovery email (1–168; defaults to 24).

dry_run.description: Defaults to true for set; pass false to apply.

date_from.description: Start date for the report period (YYYY-MM-DD, default: 30 days ago)

date_to.description: End date for the report period (YYYY-MM-DD, default: today)

update_existing.description: Update posts whose slug already exists. Default false.

include_variation_ids.description: Include the list of attached product variation IDs for each bundle. Defaults to false.

only_active.description: Return only is_active bundles. Defaults to false (all bundles).

bundle_id.description: The bundle to change membership in.

action.description: One of: pin, unpin, exclude, unexclude.

bundle_id.description: Preview this bundle's currently stored rule. Omit when previewing an inline `rules` list instead.

rules.description: Hypothetical rule to preview (not saved). Each item: {field, operator, value} — same shape as bundle_upsert's `rules`. Required when bundle_id is omitted.

bundle_id.description: ID of an existing bundle to update. Omit to create a new bundle.

name.description: Bundle name shown to vendors and customers (e.g. "Any 4 for $77"). Required when creating.

quantity.description: Trigger threshold — number of cart units that activates the deal. Min 2. Required when creating.

discount_type.description: "percent", "fixed" (per-unit dollars), or "fixed_total" (dollars for the whole set). Required when creating.

discount_value.description: Percent 0–100 for "percent"; dollars for "fixed" and "fixed_total". Required when creating.

is_active.description: Whether the bundle is live. Defaults to true on create; left unchanged on update unless passed.

starts_at.description: Optional start datetime (tenant timezone, stored as UTC). Pass null to clear.

ends_at.description: Optional end datetime (tenant timezone, stored as UTC). Must be on/after starts_at. Pass null to clear.

variation_ids.description: Product variation IDs to apply the bundle to. Omit to leave membership unchanged.

rules.description: Replaces the bundle's membership rule (AND-ed conditions). Each item: {field: unit_price|category_id|exclude_category_id|weight_value|mix_match_tag|product_status|tracking_type, operator: eq|lt|lte|gt|gte|between (default eq), value}. Use exclude_category_id to omit products belonging to a category while matching another category. Pass [] or null to clear the bundle back to fully manual. Preview with bundle_rule_preview before saving. Omit to leave the current rule state untouched.

campaign_id.description: ID of the DRAFT campaign to apply the template to.

template_id.description: System template id (e.g. "summer-new-arrivals"). Omit with use_month_default=true to apply this month's calendar default.

use_month_default.description: When true and template_id is omitted, applies the month_calendar default for month (or the current month in the tenant timezone).

month.description: Calendar month 1-12 for month_calendar lookup when use_month_default is true. Defaults to the current month.

contact_list_ids.description: Contact list IDs to scope the split. Omit or pass [] to use all subscribed contacts + customers.

include_customers.description: Include store customers in the audience. Defaults to true.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to pause or resume.

dry_run.description: If true (default), report without writing. Pass false to apply.

label.description: set: a short name for the pack, e.g. "Past in-house flyers".

prompt_lines.description: set: the art direction, one short line each. Replaces what is saved.

media_ids.description: set: media library ids to use as style references. They move into the style-reference folder.

clear_images.description: clear: also take the images out of the style-reference folder. They stay in the library.

theme.description: What the flyer is for, in plain words. E.g. "September restock — cosy autumn mood, warm light".

product_ids.description: Product IDs to feature. Their photos anchor the artwork. Omit to auto-pick the newest featured products that have images.

campaign_id.description: DRAFT campaign to place the artwork into. Omit to only add it to the media library.

slot_index.description: 1-based image slot to fill. Defaults to 1, the hero slot.

aspect_ratio.description: Shape of the artwork: "4:3" (default, email banner), "1:1", "16:9", "3:4". Anything else falls back to the default.

alt_text.description: Alt text for the placed image. Defaults to the theme.

reference_media_ids.description: Media library ids of images to use as one-off style/composition references for THIS generation (e.g. a past flyer the vendor just attached to this chat — its media_id is noted right after the attachment). Max 3. Not persisted; use campaign_flyer_style_pack for a look that should repeat.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to read.
ID of the campaign to unstick.

include_failed.description: Reset failed recipients to pending. Default true.

reset_stale_sending.description: Reset stuck status=sending recipients to pending. Default true.

retry_sending_log_errors.description: Retry recipients listed in the campaign sending error log (retryable types only). Default false.

dispatch_limit.description: Max immediate send jobs when retry_sending_log_errors=true (default 200, max 500).

dry_run.description: If true (default), report counts without writing. Pass false to apply.

campaign_id.description: ID of the campaign to send a test copy of.

to_email.description: Email address for an email campaign test copy.

to_phone.description: Phone number for a text campaign test copy (E.164 or local format).

campaign_id.description: ID of the DRAFT campaign to place the image into.

media_id.description: ID of a public image in the tenant's media library to insert.

slot_index.description: 1-based placeholder to fill when the body has more than one. Defaults to the first.

alt_text.description: Override alt text. Defaults to the media asset's own alt text, then the campaign name.

campaign_id.description: Load content from this campaign. Omit to score inline subject/html_body or sms_body.

channel.description: "email" or "sms". Required when scoring inline content without campaign_id.

for_send.description: If true, fold the send-time deep check into the same 0–100 score (email only). Default false (live rules).

campaign_id.description: ID of an existing campaign to edit. Omit to create a new draft.

name.description: Internal campaign name (max 120 chars). Required when creating.

channel.description: "email" (default) or "sms" (text blast). Only set on create.

subject.description: Email subject line shown to recipients (max 200 chars). Required when creating an email campaign.

fallback_first_name.description: Stand-in when {{first_name}} is blank (max 80). Empty string clears. Omit on update to keep.

html_body.description: Full email HTML. Sanitized on save. Use {{unsubscribe_url}}, {{first_name}}, {{last_name}} tokens.

sms_body.description: Text message body for SMS campaigns (max 1600 chars). Required when creating a text campaign.

plain_body.description: Optional plain-text alternative. Auto-derived from the HTML at send time if omitted.

mode.description: "smtp" (default) or "webhook". Left unchanged on update unless passed.

audience_includes_customers.description: Whether to include the tenant's customers in the audience. Defaults to true on create.

base_name.description: The group to merge, exactly as returned by catalog_flattening_audit (e.g. "GLITTER BOMB | TOP SHELF FLOWER").

dry_run.description: Defaults to TRUE — shows the plan without changing anything. Pass false to actually merge.

categories.description: Categories to ensure exist. Parents must appear before children.

products.description: Complete explicit members: product_id and the clean variant_name for every source product.

category_id.description: ID of an existing category. Required for update and delete.

name.description: Category name shown to customers. Required when creating.

slug.description: URL slug, unique per tenant. Auto-generated from name when omitted on create.

meta_title.description: SEO title override (max 60). Empty string clears.

meta_description.description: SEO meta description override (max 160). Empty string clears.

parent_id.description: Parent category id, or null for a top-level category.

is_active.description: Whether the category is visible on the storefront.

is_featured.description: Whether the category appears in the homepage featured grid.

media_id.description: Media library asset id to set as image_path (the branded, customer-facing image).

base_media_id.description: Media library asset id to set as base_image_path (the unbranded source canvas).

statuses.description: Which validation statuses to purge. Defaults to ["invalid"]. Only "invalid" and "risky" are allowed; "unknown" is refused because those contacts are simply not graded yet.

list_id.description: Limit the purge to one contact list. Omit to sweep every list in the store.

dry_run.description: Defaults to TRUE — reports what would be deleted without deleting. Pass false to actually delete.

only_active.description: Return only is_active coupons. Defaults to false (all coupons).

coupon_id.description: ID of an existing coupon to update. Omit to create a new coupon.

code.description: Coupon code customers enter at checkout (case-insensitive, stored uppercase). Required when creating.

value.description: Percent 0-100 for "percentage"; dollars for "fixed"; ignored for "free_delivery". Required when creating (pass 0 for free_delivery).

min_order.description: Minimum order subtotal in dollars required to use the coupon. Omit or 0 for no minimum.

freebie_id.description: ID of a Freebie (from freebie_list) to link, making this a code-triggered freebie. Pass null to unlink.

max_uses.description: Total redemption cap across all customers. Omit/null for unlimited.

max_uses_per_customer.description: Redemption cap per customer, matched via limit_match_by. Defaults to 1.

limit_match_by.description: "email", "phone", or "both" — how max_uses_per_customer is enforced. "phone"/"both" require the tenant's phone-at-checkout setting to be on.

applies_to.description: "all", "products", or "categories". See tool description for applies_to_ids.

applies_to_ids.description: Product ids (applies_to="products") or category ids (applies_to="categories") this coupon is scoped to. All must belong to this tenant. Pass [] to clear.

requires_subscribed_customer.description: Newsletter-subscriber-exclusive code: when true, only a registered customer who has NOT opted out of marketing email (email_opt_out=false) can redeem it. Gates to store customers only — never platform leads. Guests are always rejected. Defaults to false.

subscription_ladder_id.description: ID of an existing SubscriptionDiscountLadder to link. Pass null to unlink. See tool description.

contact_list_id.description: Optional tenant-owned manual or Smart List id. Only list members may redeem the coupon; pass null to unlink.

ladder_start_percent.description: Mounting ladder: percent off for orders before start_order_index. 0-100. See tool description.

ladder_step_percent.description: Mounting ladder: percent the discount climbs each order once past start_order_index. 0-100. See tool description.

ladder_cap_percent.description: Mounting ladder: ceiling percent the discount pegs at once reached. 0-100. See tool description.

ladder_start_order_index.description: Mounting ladder: 1-based order number the climb begins at. See tool description.

is_active.description: Whether the coupon is live. Defaults to true on create; left unchanged on update unless passed.

starts_at.description: Optional start date (tenant timezone, stored as UTC start-of-day). Pass null to clear.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry date (tenant timezone, stored as UTC end-of-day). Must be on/after starts_at. Pass null to clear.

customer_id.description: Exact customer ID from customer_lookup; never guess from a name

target.description: Default both. Select email or phone explicitly if the other is missing/invalid.

dry_run.description: Default true: preview without changing any block

confirm.description: Must be true when applying an authorized mutation

expected_snapshot.description: Snapshot from customer_block_status or preview; required when dry_run=false

customer_id.description: Exact customer ID from customer_lookup; never guess from a name

limit.description: Number of customer messages to return, from 1 to 25.

updated_since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only return customers updated at or after this time (optional)

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's next_cursor — omit to start from the first page

phone.description: Customer phone number, digits or formatted (optional)

limit.description: Number of matches to return (default 10, max 25)

conversation_id.description: Existing customer email or live-chat conversation to reply to.

body.description: Proposed customer-facing message. Plain, specific, and ready for staff review.

email.description: New email address (must be unique within the tenant)

phone.description: New phone number, digits or formatted

email_opt_out.description: Set true to suppress marketing email. Cannot be set to false — un-suppression happens in DabDash only.

sms_marketing_opt_out.description: Set true to suppress marketing texts. Cannot be set to false.

sms_notifications_muted.description: Set true to mute transactional/order SMS notifications. Cannot be set to false.

body.description: Specific delay update for this customer.

proof_of_delivery_requirement.description: none, photo, signature, either, or both.

only_active.description: Return only is_active freebies. Defaults to false (all freebies).

freebie_id.description: ID of an existing freebie to update. Omit to create a new freebie.

name.description: Freebie name shown to vendors (e.g. "Spend $50 Get Papers"). Required when creating.

product_id.description: The product given away. Must belong to this tenant. Required when creating.

variation_id.description: Optional specific variation of product_id to give away. Must belong to this tenant. Pass null to clear.

spend_threshold.description: Minimum cart spend in dollars that triggers this freebie. Required when creating.

quantity.description: How many units of the product/variation are given away once triggered. Required when creating.

is_stackable.description: Whether this rule can combine with other freebie rules on the same order. Defaults to false.

is_active.description: Whether the freebie is live. Defaults to true on create; left unchanged on update unless passed.

starts_at.description: Optional start date (tenant timezone, stored as UTC). Pass null to clear.

ends_at.description: Optional end date (tenant timezone, stored as UTC). Must be on/after starts_at. Pass null to clear.

category_ids.description: Category IDs to scope this freebie to. Must belong to this tenant; foreign ids are ignored. Omit to leave unchanged; pass an empty array to clear all.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 30, max 365)

product_ids.description: List of product IDs to look up.

cutoff_iso.description: ISO8601 timestamp. The last quantity_after strictly BEFORE this moment is returned for each variation. Example: "2026-05-03T00:00:00Z".

alert_only.description: If true, return only low-stock and out-of-stock items (default false)

enabled.description: Turn the loyalty program on or off.

redeem_points_per_dollar.description: Points needed to redeem one dollar (1–100000).

skip_on_coupon.description: When true, orders using a coupon earn no points.

tiers_enabled.description: Enable the configured lifetime tier ladder.

tiers.description: Lifetime tier definitions, sorted automatically by lifetime_points.

platform.description: Inspect a platform-owned mailbox (tenant_id IS NULL). When true, tenant_slug is ignored and email_account_id is required.

email_account_id.description: Specific EmailAccount id (required for platform=true; optional for tenant_slug — defaults to the tenant's single mailbox).

category_id.description: Storefront swag mode: composite the platform branding onto this category via SwagImagesService instead of the manual layout below. At most one of category_id or widget_id.

widget_id.description: Storefront swag mode: composite the platform branding onto this widget via SwagImagesService instead of the manual layout below. At most one of category_id or widget_id.

base_media_id.description: ID of a library image to use as the background. Provide exactly one of base_media_id or base_url.

base_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the background image. Provide exactly one of base_media_id or base_url.

logo_media_id.description: ID of a library image to place on top, unaltered. At most one of logo_media_id or logo_url.

logo_url.description: Public http(s) URL of the logo to place on top, unaltered.

headline.description: Large text under the logo (max 120 chars). Wrapped to at most 2 lines.

subtitle.description: Smaller text under the headline (max 200 chars). Wrapped to at most 3 lines.

font.description: Typeface: anton, bebas, oswald, playfair, sans, serif. Defaults to "sans".

logo_position.description: Vertical placement of the whole block: "top", "center" (default) or "bottom".

logo_width_pct.description: Logo width as a fraction of the base width, 0.05-0.90. Defaults to 0.30.

subtitle_color.description: Subtitle colour as #RRGGBB. Defaults to text_color.

headline_size_pct.description: Headline size as a fraction of base width, 0.01-0.25. Defaults to 0.07.

subtitle_size_pct.description: Subtitle size as a fraction of base width, 0.01-0.15. Defaults to 0.035.

scrim.description: Darkening behind the logo/text for legibility: "none", "soft" (default) or "strong".

text_shadow.description: Draw a soft shadow under the text. Defaults to true.

filename.description: Filename to record for the new asset (e.g. "natal-day-hero.png").

alt_text.description: Alt text for accessibility and captions (max 500 chars).

folder.description: Library folder to group the asset under (max 100 chars).
Only return assets in this exact library folder.

search.description: Filter by a substring of the original filename.

source_url.description: Public http(s) URL to fetch the image from. Provide exactly one source.

source_path.description: Local file path to read the image from. Provide exactly one source.

source_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (data: prefix optional). Provide exactly one source.

filename.description: Original filename to record (e.g. "summer-flyer.png"). Defaults to a derived name.

alt_text.description: Alt text for accessibility and captions (max 500 chars).

folder.description: Optional library folder to group the asset under (max 100 chars).

notify_new_enquiry.description: Contact form and enquiry email together. Off hides the storefront contact form and stops the email.

customer_phone.description: Customer phone number, digits or formatted (optional)

updated_since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only orders updated at or after this time (optional)

limit.description: Number of orders to return (default 25, max 100)

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the previous response; omit to start at the newest order

include_items.description: Include order line items for sync/export use (default false)

structure_id.description: ID of the shared BUNDLE structure to assign. Must NOT be a hidden (inline) structure.

product_slugs.description: List of product slugs to assign to this structure. Provide product_slugs or product_ids (or both).

product_ids.description: List of product IDs to assign to this structure. Provide product_slugs or product_ids (or both).

structure_ids.description: List of structure IDs to delete. Bundle structures are always accepted; inline structures are only accepted when product_count=0.

force.description: If true, deletes even if products are still assigned (they will be orphaned — use only after migrating products). Requires orphan_products_acknowledged=true alongside.

orphan_products_acknowledged.description: Explicit acknowledgment that force=true will orphan products. Required when force=true and any structure has product_count > 0. Defaults to false.

kind.description: Filter by kind: "inline" for hidden 1:1 structures, "bundle" for shared structures, or omit for all.

include_tiers.description: Include tier details for each structure. Defaults to false.

include_product_ids.description: Include the list of product IDs assigned to each structure. Defaults to false.

product_id.description: The product whose pricing structure and variations will be rebuilt.

tracking_type.description: Tracking type for the new inline structure: simple, unit, weight, matrix, matrix_unit.

inventory_mode.description: Inventory mode override: "product" or "variation". If omitted, defaults are applied per tracking_type rules (weight→product, matrix→variation).

product_stock_quantity.description: When inventory_mode=product, the value to set on products.stock_quantity. Ignored otherwise.

tiers.description: Array of tiers. Each: {name (string, required), price (dollars, required), compare_at_price (dollars, nullable), cost_price (dollars, nullable), weight_grams (number, required for weight/matrix), mix_match_tags (array, nullable), stock_quantity (number, required), restore_variation_id (int, optional — re-uses an existing variation row).}

delete_unreferenced.description: If true, hard-deletes variations not referenced in tiers. Default false (deactivates them).

structure_id.description: ID of an existing BUNDLE structure to update. Must NOT be a hidden (inline) structure. Omit to create a new bundle or to edit inline via product_slug/product_id.

product_slug.description: Product slug for inline (1:1) mode. Identifies which product's hidden structure to edit. Mutually exclusive with structure_id.

product_id.description: Product id for inline (1:1) mode. Alternative to product_slug. Mutually exclusive with structure_id.

name.description: Structure name. Required when creating a bundle. Ignored for inline structures (name is derived from the product name).

tracking_type.description: Pricing type: simple, weight, unit, matrix, or matrix_unit. Required when creating. For updates, changing tracking_type re-syncs all linked products.

tiers.description: Replacement tier list. Each tier: {name (string, required), weight_grams (number, required for weight/matrix), price (dollars, required), compare_at_price (dollars, nullable), cost_price (dollars, nullable), mix_match_tags (array of strings, nullable)}.

product_ids.description: Product ids to update. Required for action=set.

featured.description: Value to set is_featured to for product_ids. Required for action=set.

media_id.description: Tenant media library asset id for featured_image.

gallery_media_ids.description: Tenant media library asset ids that replace gallery_images (empty array clears).

clear_featured.description: When true, clear featured_image. Mutually exclusive with media_id.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing featured_image. Defaults false.

assignments.description: Explicit product_id/strain_id pairs to assign. Mutually exclusive with auto_match.

auto_match.description: When true, find and assign matches automatically instead of using assignments.

search.description: auto_match only: filter candidate products by name.

limit.description: auto_match only: max products to consider. Default 25, max 100.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing featured_image. Defaults false.

product_ids.description: Limit the search to these product ids. Omit to scan all products missing a featured image.

search.description: Filter candidate products by name (case-insensitive contains).

limit.description: Max products to propose matches for. Default 25, max 100.

product_id.description: Exact product id (optional if name_query or sku supplied)

name_query.description: Partial product name match (optional if product_id or sku supplied)

sku.description: Exact SKU of a variation belonging to the product (optional if product_id or name_query supplied). SKUs are unique per tenant.

product_id.description: Existing product id required for update.

name.description: Product name shown to customers. Required for create.

price.description: Unit price in dollars (e.g. 24.99). Omit to leave $0 until edited.

stock_quantity.description: On-hand unit count. Omit to leave unset.

description.description: Product description. Strain enrich fills this when omitted.

meta_title.description: SEO title override (max 60). Empty string clears.

meta_description.description: SEO meta description override (max 160). Empty string clears.

strain_id.description: Platform strain id from strain_lookup. Copies strain data onto the product.

skip_strain_enrich.description: If true, do not auto-match or apply a strain from the product name.

expected_variation_count.description: Required with variations: exact number of variation rows; partial payloads are rejected.

variations.description: Complete named variant rows. Each row requires name, price, and stock_quantity.

date_from.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD (default: 90 days ago in tenant TZ).

date_to.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD (default: today in tenant TZ).

only_in_stock.description: When true, drop out-of-stock catalog products (default false).

require_cost.description: When true (default), only lines with cost_price > 0 are ranked.

min_price.description: Minimum price per unit in dollars (optional)

max_price.description: Maximum price per unit in dollars (optional)

sku.description: Exact SKU of the product's variation. SKUs are unique per tenant.

stock_quantity.description: New absolute stock quantity (unit count, not grams). Omit to leave stock unchanged.

price.description: New price in dollars (e.g. 24.99). Omit to leave price unchanged.

product_ids.description: Exact tenant product ids to update.

order_number.description: Optional order number to compare against configured promotions

include_inactive.description: Include inactive or expired promotions too (optional)

notes.description: Optional notes stored on the draft (invoice number, delivery date, etc.).

purchase_order_id.description: Draft purchase order id from purchase_order_draft_create.

variation_id.description: Size/variation id when the product uses variation inventory.

qty.description: Quantity to order (grams or units, matching the product).

unit_cost.description: Unit cost in dollars. Omit to use the last cost for this supplier.

match_confidence.description: How confident the catalog match is, from 0 to 1. Pass when importing from OCR.

hours.description: Lookback window for notification history in hours (default 72, max 720)

limit.description: Max recent notifications to return (default 50, max 200)

enabled.description: Allow verified customers to submit product reviews.

review_id.description: Product review ID for hide or unhide.

dry_run.description: Defaults to true for set, hide, and unhide; pass false to apply.

days.description: Number of days to look back (default 30, max 365)

button_text_color.description: "auto" (default), "white" or "dark" — text colour on primary/accent buttons.

hero_title.description: Primary hero title, up to 100 characters.

hero_description.description: Full hero description, up to 500 characters.

hero_cta_text.description: Primary hero CTA, up to 50 characters.

hero_eyebrow.description: Modern hero eyebrow, up to 60 characters.

hero_spotlight_mode.description: Modern hero card: auto (newest sale), product (pin one), or off (hide).

hero_spotlight_product_id.description: Active product id to pin on the Modern hero card. Pins the card unless mode is also passed.

hero_spotlight_product.description: Active product name or slug to pin on the Modern hero card. Ignored when hero_spotlight_product_id is set.

hero_ticker_mode.description: Modern ticker: auto, custom, or off.

hero_status_mode.description: Modern hero last-call pill: hours, auto, or off.

minimum_age.description: Storefront age gate minimum age (e.g. 19 for Nova Scotia).

footer_notes.description: Modern footer notes, one per line (up to 4).

privacy_url.description: Authoritative absolute privacy-policy URL; may be this store's published blog URL.

delivery_meta_description.description: Optional /delivery page meta description, up to 160 characters.

social_facebook.description: Absolute Facebook page URL for schema sameAs.

social_instagram.description: Absolute Instagram profile URL for schema sameAs.

social_twitter.description: Absolute Twitter profile URL for schema sameAs.

social_x.description: Absolute X.com profile URL for schema sameAs.

google_business_url.description: Absolute Google Business / Maps URL for schema sameAs.

gbp_url.description: Absolute Google Business Profile URL for schema sameAs.

live_chat_enabled.description: Show the tenant-scoped storefront live chat widget.

freebie_cost_in_cogs.description: Include freebie wholesale cost in COGS / profit reports (default true).

legacy_wix_redirects.description: Enable Cloudflare Single Redirects for the Wix legacy profile on this tenant zone.

legacy_wordpress_redirects.description: Enable Cloudflare Single Redirects for the WordPress legacy profile on this tenant zone.

wordpress_cutover.description: Mark WordPress cutover complete (pairs with legacy_wordpress_redirects for CF sync).

hero_ticker_items.description: Custom ticker rows; replaces existing rows.

opening_hours.description: Opening hour rows. Replaces existing rows; [] clears.

whatsapp_number.description: WhatsApp number. Adds a Chat button. Leave empty to hide it.

footer_newsletter_title.description: Signup heading. Use | to colour the second part. Maximum 60 characters.

footer_notes.description: Notes under the delivery areas. One per line. Update your hours, prices and service details here. Leave empty to hide. Maximum 60 characters.

home_gifts_title.description: Heading. Use | to colour the second part. Maximum 60 characters.

delivery_band_note.description: Text after the amount Maximum 30 characters.

delivery_band_pills.description: Tags. One per line. For example: $50 minimum. Maximum 30 characters.

home_fresh_title.description: Heading. Use | to colour the second part. Maximum 60 characters.

about_closer.description: Closing text. Two lines at most. The second one is bold. Maximum 320 characters.

about_cta_label.description: Closing button. Links to your products. Maximum 30 characters.

post.summary:
Override one variation's membership in one bundle, independent of whatever a bundle's rule
(GitHub #395 "smart collections") would otherwise decide. Precedence is always
excluded > pinned > rule — this is how you handle "this tenant is mostly automatic but this one
variation needs to stay in/out no matter what the rule says".

action:
  pin       Force this variation INTO the bundle. Survives every future rule recompute. Also
            clears any existing exclusion for it (a deliberate "include this" beats an earlier
            "exclude this").
  unpin     Remove an explicit pin. If the bundle's rule still matches this variation, the next
            recompute (which runs automatically here) puts it back as an automatic ("rule") member;
            otherwise it simply falls out.
  exclude   Force this variation OUT of the bundle, immediately, even if it's currently pinned or
            rule-matched. Never re-added by a rule recompute until unexcluded.
  unexclude Lift an exclusion. If the rule still matches, the next recompute (run automatically
            here) re-adds it as an automatic member; it is NOT automatically pinned.

pin/exclude/unpin/unexclude all work on fully-manual bundles too (a bundle with no rule) — they
just directly add/remove the pivot row in that case, same as the vendor bundle picker's
pin/exclude buttons.

Call bundle_list or bundle_rule_preview first to find the right bundle_id and variation_id.

post.summary:
Read-only. Shows what a bundle membership rule ("smart collection" — GitHub #395) would match,
WITHOUT writing anything. Use this before bundle_upsert to sanity-check a rule against a live
tenant's catalog rather than guessing blind.

Two ways to call it:
  - Pass `bundle_id` to preview a bundle's CURRENTLY STORED rule (what recompute() would do right now).
  - Pass `rules` (and no bundle_id) to preview a HYPOTHETICAL rule that hasn't been saved anywhere —
    "what would this match if I set it up this way". The rule is evaluated in-memory only.
Passing both previews the inline `rules` against that bundle's tenant, ignoring its stored rule.

Each condition is {field, operator, value} — the same shape bundle_upsert's `rules` field takes:
  field: unit_price (cents) | category_id | exclude_category_id | weight_value (grams) | mix_match_tag | product_status
         (draft|active|archived) | tracking_type (weight|unit|matrix)
  operator: eq (default) | lt | lte | gt | gte | between (value must be [min, max])
Conditions are AND-ed. An empty rules list matches nothing (a bundle only auto-populates once it
has at least one condition).

Returns the total match count plus up to 20 sample variations (id, product name, size/weight,
current price) so you can eyeball whether the rule caught the right things before committing it.

post.summary:
Create or update a bundle deal (mix & match) on behalf of a tenant. Bundles are the live cart
engine: a bundle fires when a cart holds at least `quantity` units across its attached variations.

UPDATE MODE (bundle_id provided):
  Edits the bundle. Only the fields you pass are changed; omitted fields are left as-is.

CREATE MODE (no bundle_id):
  Creates a new bundle. name, quantity, discount_type, and discount_value are required.

DISCOUNT VALUE UNITS — read carefully, this is the common mistake:
  discount_type = "percent"      → discount_value is a percentage 0–100 (e.g. 20 = 20% off each unit).
  discount_type = "fixed"        → discount_value is DOLLARS off PER UNIT (e.g. 5 = $5 off each).
  discount_type = "fixed_total"  → discount_value is the DOLLARS TOTAL for the whole set
                                    (e.g. quantity=4, discount_value=77 → "any 4 for $77").
  For fixed and fixed_total, pass dollars (e.g. 77 or 77.00) — the tool stores cents internally.
  For percent, pass the percentage (e.g. 20), NOT a fraction.

VARIATIONS:
  variation_ids + variation_mode control which product variations the bundle applies to.
  mode "replace" (default) sets membership to exactly variation_ids; "add" attaches them to the
  existing set; "detach" removes them. Variations not owned by the tenant are ignored.
  Omit variation_ids entirely to leave membership untouched.

SCHEDULE:
  starts_at / ends_at are interpreted in the tenant's timezone and stored as UTC. Pass null/omit
  for an always-on bundle.

RULES (smart collections — GitHub #395):
  Pass `rules` to turn this bundle into a rule-based ("smart collection") bundle: membership is
  computed automatically from a list of AND-ed conditions instead of a fixed variation_ids list.
  Each condition is {field, operator, value}:
    field: unit_price (cents) | category_id | exclude_category_id | weight_value (grams) | mix_match_tag | product_status
           (draft|active|archived) | tracking_type (weight|unit|matrix)
    operator: eq (default) | lt | lte | gt | gte | between (value must be [min, max])
  On save, membership is recomputed immediately: variations matching every condition are added as
  "rule" members. Pinned members and explicit exclusions (see bundle_membership) are never touched
  or overridden by a rule — excluded beats pinned beats rule. The response reports how many
  variations were added/removed by this recompute.
  ALWAYS call bundle_rule_preview with your intended rules BEFORE saving them here — it shows
  exactly what would match without writing anything, so you don't fire a rule blind against a
  live tenant's catalog.
  Passing `rules: []` or `rules: null` explicitly clears the bundle back to fully manual: existing
  membership is left as-is (nothing is auto-removed), but it stops auto-updating and variation_ids
  takes over again.
  Omit `rules` entirely to leave a bundle's current rule state (manual or automatic) untouched.

Always call bundle_list first to get the bundle_id and confirm the current configuration.

Generate BESPOKE flyer artwork for a campaign from the shop's own product photos, then drop it
straight into the campaign design. This is the intended way to make a marketing email look like
a designed flyer instead of a text layout — reach for it before writing copy, because the rest of
the email is built to sit under the artwork.

WHAT IT PRODUCES:
  A layered, dimensional flyer illustration in the shop's brand colours, composed around the real
  packaging from the product photos you name. It renders NO text — the email supplies every word
  as real text so it stays readable, translatable, and safe with images disabled.

REQUIREMENTS:
  The shop must have its own AI key connected (Settings → Dab AI). Generation is billed to that
  key, not to the platform, so a shop without one gets a clear message instead of a flyer. Use
  the highest-quality model available on the key; that is the default and it is the point.
  A shop that has saved a style pack (campaign_flyer_style_pack) automatically gets its own past
  flyers attached as references, so the artwork matches the creative it already sends.

HOW TO USE IT:
  - theme        — what the flyer is for, in plain words ("September restock, cosy autumn mood").
  - product_ids  — the products to feature. Omit and it picks the shop's newest featured products
                   that actually have photos.
  - campaign_id  — a DRAFT campaign to place the artwork into. Omit to just add it to the media
                   library and place it later with campaign_set_image.
  - slot_index   — which image slot to fill (1-based). Defaults to the first, which is the hero.
  - reference_media_ids — if the vendor just attached a past flyer (or any image) to THIS chat and
                   asked for something "in the same style" or "like this one", pass its media_id
                   here. The conversation shows it as "[Library image saved: media_id=N, ...]"
                   right after the attachment. This is a one-off style/composition reference for
                   this generation only — it steers mood, layout and palette, it is never
                   reproduced verbatim, and it is not saved for next time. Never ask the vendor
                   for a URL or to re-upload when their image is already attached to the chat —
                   read its media_id from the conversation and pass it here instead. For a shop
                   that wants the same look on every flyer going forward, save it once with
                   campaign_flyer_style_pack instead of repeating reference_media_ids.

Typical flow: campaign_upsert (create) → campaign_apply_template (design) →
campaign_upsert (real copy) → campaign_generate_flyer (hero artwork LAST) → campaign_send_test.

replacement, so calling campaign_upsert again after the artwork is placed erases it.

The result always lands in the media library, so it can be reused on the storefront or in a later

applied at checkout (distinct from bundles, which fire automatically on cart contents — use

VALUE UNITS:
  type = "percentage"     → value is a percentage 0-100 off the order subtotal.
  type = "fixed"          → value is DOLLARS off the order subtotal (e.g. 10 = $10 off).
  type = "free_delivery"  → value is ignored (pass 0); this type only waives the delivery fee.

min_order is a dollar minimum order subtotal required to use the coupon (pass dollars, e.g. 25
for a $25 minimum — the tool stores cents internally). Omit or pass 0 for no minimum.

freebie_id links this coupon to an existing Freebie (see freebie_list/freebie_upsert), turning it
into a "code-triggered freebie": a customer who applies the code while below min_order has the
code parked (kept attached, not rejected) and sees cart progress toward unlocking it, instead of
the code being discarded. Pass null to unlink. The freebie must belong to the same tenant.

limit_match_by ("email"|"phone"|"both") controls how max_uses_per_customer is enforced. Using
"phone" or "both" REQUIRES the tenant's "Require phone at checkout" setting to be on — otherwise
the update is rejected, since customers without a phone on file could otherwise reuse the coupon
past its per-customer limit.

SCHEDULE:
  starts_at / expires_at are interpreted in the tenant's timezone and stored as UTC. Pass
  null/omit for an always-on coupon.

PRODUCT/CATEGORY SCOPING:
  applies_to="products" or "categories" restricts the discount to matching cart lines only —
  checkout math is fully scope-aware (a scoped coupon never discounts the whole cart). Pass
  applies_to_ids as an array of product ids (when applies_to="products") or category ids (when
  applies_to="categories") — all ids must belong to this tenant. Passing applies_to="products"/
  "categories" with an empty or omitted applies_to_ids behaves the same as "all" (no scope
  configured yet). Switching back to applies_to="all" does not automatically clear a
  previously-set applies_to_ids — pass applies_to_ids=[] explicitly to clear it.

SUBSCRIPTION MOUNTING DISCOUNT LADDERS (subscribe-and-save retention):
  A coupon can carry a "mounting ladder" so its discount climbs with each successive order a
  customer's delivery subscription generates, pegging at a ceiling — e.g. order 1 = 0% off,
  then +5% every order up to a 20% cap. This only affects orders generated for a subscription
  linked to this coupon (DeliverySubscription.coupon_id) — it has no effect on ordinary
  one-off checkout use of the code, which still uses type/value as normal.

post.summary:
Create or update a delivery/pickup/shipping zone. Use zone_manage to list or delete.

CREATE (no zone_id): name is required; a zone with the same name is updated instead.
UPDATE (zone_id): only the fields you pass change.

Coverage shape — pass ONE of:
  polygon: list of {lat, lng} points (or [lng, lat] pairs), at least 3, at most 500.
  center_lat + center_lng + radius_km: builds a 32-point circle. Good enough when
           the client only publishes a list of towns; refine the polygon later.
Fees and minimum order are in dollars. dry_run defaults true: the first call reports
what would be saved; pass dry_run=false to write.
